paragraphs: Aurinia is a biopharmaceutical company focused on delivering therapies to people living with autoimmune diseases with high unmet medical needs. In January 2021, the Company introduced LUPKYNIS® (voclosporin), the first FDA-approved oral therapy for the treatment of adult patients with active lupus nephritis ("LN"). Aurinia is also developing aritinercept, a dual inhibitor of B cell-activating factor ("BAFF") and a proliferation-inducing ligand ("APRIL") for the potential treatment of autoimmune diseases.

Aurinia sells LUPKYNIS to two specialty pharmacies and a specialty distributor in the United States ("U.S."), and Aurinia sells LUPKYNIS inventory to its collaboration partner, Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. ("Otsuka"), for the European and Japanese market.
For the year ended December 31, 2025, net product sales were $271.3 million, up 25% compared to $216.2 million in 2024.
For the year ended December 31, 2025, cash flows from operating activities were $135.7 million, up 206% compared to $44.4 million in 2024.

As of December 31, 2025, Aurinia had cash, cash equivalents, restricted cash and investments of $398.0 million, compared to $358.5 million at December 31, 2024. For the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company repurchased 12.2 million of its common shares for $98.2 million.

In December 2020, Aurinia entered into a collaboration and licensing agreement with Otsuka to develop and commercialize oral voclosporin in Japan, the European Union (the "E.U."), the United Kingdom (the "U.K."), Switzerland, Russia, Norway, Belarus, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Ukraine (collectively, the "Otsuka Territories") in exchange for: (i) a $50 million upfront cash payment; (ii) regulatory and commercial milestone payments; and (iii) royalties ranging from 10% to 20% on net sales in the Otsuka Territories.

In August 2022, Aurinia entered into a commercial supply agreement with Otsuka to: (i) supply LUPKYNIS inventory to Otsuka at cost, plus a margin; and (ii) provide manufacturing and other services, including sharing the capacity of a dedicated manufacturing facility at Lonza Ltd. ("Lonza"), Aurinia's contract manufacturing partner for voclosporin.
Otsuka has obtained regulatory approval of LUPKYNIS in Japan, the E.U., the U.K. and Switzerland.

In January 2021, the Company introduced LUPKYNIS, the first FDA-approved oral therapy for the treatment of adult patients with active LN. The Company markets LUPKYNIS in the U.S. directly through its own commercial organization. In Japan, the E.U., the U.K. and Switzerland, LUPKYNIS is marketed by Aurinia's collaboration partner, Otsuka.

LN is among the most severe and dangerous complications of systemic lupus erythematosus ("SLE"). SLE, commonly known as lupus, is a chronic autoimmune disease where the body's immune system mistakenly attacks its own healthy tissues and organs. Over 200,000 people in the U.S. are estimated to have SLE (U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention 2024), of which 20% to 60% develop LN (KDIGO Lupus Nephritis Work Group, Kidney Int 2024;105(1S):S1-S69).
a U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention 2024 b Tamirou et al., Ann Rheum Dis 2016

Proteinuria reduction is associated with long-term renal preservation. The larger the initial reduction in proteinuria in the first several months of management, the lower the risk of end-stage kidney disease ("ESKD") (Chen et al., Clin J Am Soc Nephro 2008;3(1):46-53).
a Adapted with permission from Chen et al., Clin J Am Soc Nephro 2008;3(1):46-53

b Retrospective analysis of patients (N=86) enrolled in the prospective, controlled study of plasmapheresis in severe LN to determine long-term prognosis of achieving partial response. Complete response was defined as SCr ≤1.4 mg/dL and proteinuria ≤0.33 g/day within 5 years of study entry, and partial response was defined as ≤25% increase in baseline SCr and ≥50% reduction in baseline proteinuria to ≤1.5 g/day (but >0.33 g/day) within 5 years of entering the study. Kidney survival was determined by kidney failure (≥6 mg/dL SCr or the initiation of kidney replacement therapy).

paragraphs: An investment in our common shares involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the material risks and uncertainties described below before deciding whether to purchase our common shares. Certain risks may be applicable to multiple categories but are only included once below. In assessing these risks, you should also refer to the other information contained in this Annual Report, including our audited financial statements and related notes and "Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations." Our business, financial condition, results of operations, cash flow, reputation and prospects could be materially and adversely affected by any of these risks and uncertainties, as well as other risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or that we currently do not believe to be material. In any such case, the trading price of our common shares of stock could decline, and you could lose all or part of your investment.

The success of our business is substantially dependent on our ability to successfully commercialize LUPKYNIS, our sole approved product. The Company markets LUPKYNIS in the U.S. directly through its own commercial organization. The market for effective pharmaceutical sales and marketing professionals is competitive, and maintaining these capabilities is expensive and challenging. If we are unable to maintain an effective sales and marketing organization, LUPKYNIS sales could be adversely affected, and our business may suffer. LUPKYNIS's competition as a treatment in LN patients includes BENLYSTA and GAZYVA and physicians continuing to treat LN with an off-label combination of MMF and corticosteroids alone or in combination with first generation CNIs such as tacrolimus. If we are unable to further change treatment practices, further growth of LUPKYNIS net product sales will be limited, and our business may suffer. We may also be subject to additional competition from future products.

In an effort to remain competitive in the marketplace, we may determine to change our pricing, dosage forms and strengths and other marketing strategies for LUPKYNIS, including altering the amount or availability of discounts or rebates. Any such changes could have short-term or long-term negative impacts on net product sales, which could cause our business and results of operations to suffer. Price increases or changes to our marketing strategies may also negatively affect our reputation and our ability to secure and maintain reimbursement coverage for LUPKYNIS, which could result in decreased demand and cause our business and results of operations to suffer. If we are unable to successfully price or market LUPKYNIS, the commercial prospects for LUPKYNIS will be limited, and our business may suffer.

Our estimates of the potential market size for LUPKYNIS are based on prescription and sales data for relevant in-market products, the results of clinical studies, medical literature and other information. If the potential market size for LUPKYNIS is smaller than we estimate, the commercial prospects for LUPKYNIS may be limited, and our business may suffer.

Patients suffering from LN may become gravely ill. The most commonly reported adverse reactions occurring in ≥3% of patients treated with LUPKYNIS 23.7 mg twice a day and ≥2% higher than placebo in AURORA 1 and AURA-LV were: glomerular filtration rate decreased, hypertension, diarrhea, headache, anemia, cough, urinary tract infection, abdominal pain upper, dyspepsia, alopecia, renal impairment, abdominal pain, mouth ulceration, fatigue, tremor, acute kidney injury and decreased appetite. Some patients who are treated with LUPKYNIS may die due to their underlying illness or suffer adverse events (which may or may not be drug-related).

As such, we may face product liability lawsuits. Although we carry product liability insurance, product liability lawsuits against us could cause us to incur substantial liabilities and reduce LUPKYNIS sales. Furthermore, any such lawsuits could impair our business reputation and result in the initiation of investigations by regulators.

paragraphs: Aurinia 是一家生技藥品公司，專注於為患有高未滿足醫療需求的自身免疫性疾病患者提供治療方案。2021 年 1 月，本公司推出 LUPKYNIS® (voclosporin)，為美國成人患者治療活動性紅斑狼瘡腎炎 ("LN") 的第一個美國食品藥物管理局 (FDA) 批准口服療法。Aurinia 也正在開發 aritinercept，一種同時抑制 B 細胞活化因子 ("BAFF") 和增殖誘導配體 ("APRIL") 的雙重抑制劑，用於潛在治療自身免疫性疾病。
Aurinia 在美國 ("U.S.") 銷售 LUPKYNIS 給兩家專門藥房及一家專門分銷商，並銷售 LUPKYNIS 存貨給其合作夥伴 Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. ("Otsuka")，用於歐洲及日本市場。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，淨產品銷售額為 271.3 百萬美元，較 2024 年的 216.2 百萬美元成長 25%。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，營運活動產生的現金流量為 135.7 百萬美元，較 2024 年的 44.4 百萬美元成長 206%。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，Aurinia 持有現金、現金等價物、受限現金及投資為 398.0 百萬美元，較 2024 年 12 月 31 日的 358.5 百萬美元為高。截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日，本公司購回 12.2 百萬股普通股，總金額為 98.2 百萬美元。

2020 年 12 月，Aurinia 與 Otsuka 簽訂合作與授權協議，開發並商業化口服 voclosporin 在日本、歐盟 ("E.U.")、英國 ("U.K.")、瑞士、俄羅斯、挪威、白俄羅斯、冰島、列支敦士登及烏克蘭 (合稱 "Otsuka 管轄地區")，換取：(i) 50 百萬美元的預付現金；(ii) 註冊與商業里程碑付款；以及 (iii) 在 Otsuka 管轄地區淨銷售額的 10% 至 20% 的版稅。
2022 年 8 月，Aurinia 與 Otsuka 簽訂商業供應協議，內容為：(i) 以成本供應 LUPKYNIS 存貨給 Otsuka，加上邊際利潤；以及 (ii) 提供製造及其他服務，包括共享 Lonza Ltd. ("Lonza") 的專用製造設施的容量，Lonza 是 Aurinia 的委外製造夥伴，用於 voclosporin 的製造。
Otsuka 已在日本、E.U.、U.K. 及瑞士取得 LUPKYNIS 的監管批准。
2021年1月，本公司推出LUPKYNIS，為美國成人活動性LN患者治療所批准的首個口服療法。本公司透過自身的商業組織直接在美國銷售LUPKYNIS。在日本、歐盟、英國及瑞士，LUPKYNIS則由Aurinia的合作夥伴Otsuka銷售。
LN為系統性紅斑狼瘡（"SLE"）最嚴重且危險的併發症之一。SLE，常被稱為紅斑狼瘡，是一種慢性自身免疫疾病，身體的免疫系統錯誤地攻擊自身的健康組織與器官。美國估計有超過200,000人患有SLE（美國疾病管制與預防中心，2024），其中20%至60%會發展為LN（KDIGO紅斑狼瘡腎炎工作小組，腎臟國際，2024;105(1S):S1-S69）。
a 美國疾病管制與預防中心，2024 b Tamirou等人，英國風濕病學雜誌，2016
減少蛋白尿與長期腎臟保護有關。在管理的前幾個月內，初始蛋白尿減少的程度越大，發生終末期腎病（"ESKD"）的風險越低（Chen等人，美國腎臟學會臨牀期刊，2008;3(1):46-53）。
a 獲許可轉載自Chen等人，美國腎臟學會臨牀期刊，2008;3(1):46-53

b 對於參與前瞻性、控制性研究的患者（N=86）進行回溯分析，以確定在嚴重LN中進行血漿置換治療後，達成部分反應的長期預後。完全反應定義為在入組後5年內，SCr ≤1.4 mg/dL 且蛋白尿 ≤0.33 g/天；部分反應定義為在入組後5年內，基線SCr增加 ≤25% 且基線蛋白尿減少 ≥50% 至 ≤1.5 g/天（但 >0.33 g/天）。腎臟存活由腎臟衰竭（SCr ≥6 mg/dL 或開始腎臟替代治療）決定。

paragraphs: 您應閱讀下列對我們財務狀況及營運成果之討論與分析，並配合我們合併財務報表及其附註、及其他財務資訊，一併審閱本年度報告。部分包含於本討論與分析中的資訊，包括有關我們業務計畫與策略之資訊，係屬前瞻性陳述，涉及風險與不確定性。您應審閱本年度報告中所列之「風險因素」，以瞭解可能導致我們實際結果與本討論與分析中所描述或暗示之前瞻性陳述所預期結果有重大差異的重要因素。
以下一般討論 2025 年與 2024 年之項目，以及 2025 年與 2024 年之年對年比較。未包含於本討論中之 2023 年項目及 2024 年與 2023 年之年對年比較，可於我們 2024 年 12 月 31 日為財務年度終結之年度報告（Form 10-K）中「管理層對財務狀況與營運成果之討論與分析」部分找到，該報告已於 2025 年 2 月 27 日向 SEC 提交。

Aurinia 為一專注於提供治療患有高未滿足醫療需求之自身免疫疾病患者之生物製藥公司。2021 年 1 月，本公司推出 LUPKYNIS®（voclosporin），為美國食品藥物管理局（FDA）批准之首個口服療法，用於治療患有活動性紅斑狼瘡腎炎（"LN"）之成人患者。Aurinia 亦正在開發 aritinercept，為一同時抑制 B 細胞活化因子（"BAFF"）與增殖誘導配體（"APRIL"）之雙重抑制劑，用於潛在治療自身免疫疾病。
下表顯示我們 2025 年 12 月 31 日及 2024 年 12 月 31 日財年之營運成果（單位為千美元）：
Aurinia 將 LUPKYNIS 零組件銷售給美國（"U.S."）的兩間專門藥房及一間專門分銷商，並將 LUPKYNIS 存貨銷售給其合作夥伴 Otsuka Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. ("Otsuka")，用以服務歐洲及日本市場。這兩間專門藥房、專門分銷商及 Otsuka，於會計用途上被視為本公司客戶。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年，淨產品銷售額為 271.3 百萬美元，較 2024 年的 216.2 百萬美元成長 25%。此成長主要係因銷售至專門藥房的 LUPKYNIS 包裝數量增加，驅動 LN 市場滲透率進一步提升。
授權、合作及版稅收入

授權、合作及版稅收入係指與 Otsuka 簽訂的合作與授權協議所產生的收入，用以開發及商業化口服 voclosporin 在日本、歐盟（"E.U."）、英國（"U.K."）、瑞士、俄羅斯、挪威、白俄羅斯、冰島、列支敦士登及烏克蘭（合稱 "Otsuka 管轄地區"）的收入，換取：(i) 50 百萬美元的 upfront 現金支付；(ii) 註冊與商業里程碑付款；以及 (iii) 在 Otsuka 管轄地區的淨銷售額，版稅率為 10% 至 20%。
授權、合作及版稅收入亦包含與 Otsuka 簽訂的商業供應協議所產生的收入，用以提供製造及其他服務，包括共享 Lonza Ltd. ("Lonza") 的專用製造設施的容量，Aurinia 的委外製造夥伴為 voclosporin 提供製造服務。
截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日財年，授權、合作及版稅收入為 11.7 百萬美元，較 2024 年的 18.9 百萬美元減少 38%。2024 年 12 月 31 日財年包含與 LUPKYNIS 在日本取得藥品核准相關的里程碑付款 10.0 百萬美元。

paragraphs: 投資本公司的普通股涉及高度風險。您應在決定是否購買本公司普通股前，仔細考慮下列所描述的重大多數風險與不確定性。某些風險可能適用於多個類別，但僅在下方列出一次。在評估這些風險時，您也應參考本年度報告中包含的其他資訊，包括我們經審計的財務報表及其相關附註及「管理層對財務狀況與營運結果之討論與分析」。本公司業務、財務狀況、營運結果、現金流、聲譽與前景可能因任何這些風險與不確定性，以及目前未為我們所知或我們目前認為不具重大性之其他風險與不確定性，而受到重大且不利的影響。在任何情況下，本公司普通股的交易價格可能下跌，您可能損失全部或部分投資。

本公司業務的成功在很大程度上取決於我們能否成功商業化LUPKYNIS，這是本公司唯一核准的產品。本公司透過自身的商業組織直接在美國市場推廣LUPKYNIS。有效藥物銷售與行銷專業人員的市場競爭激烈，維持這些能力成本高昂且具有挑戰性。若我們無法維持有效的銷售與行銷組織，LUPKYNIS的銷售可能受到不利影響，而本公司業務可能受損。作為治療LN患者的LUPKYNIS競爭產品包括BENLYSTA和GAZYVA，以及醫師持續以非標籤組合方式使用MMF與類固醇單獨或與第一代CNIs如他克莫司組合來治療LN。若我們無法進一步改變治療習慣，LUPKYNIS淨產品銷售的進一步成長將受到限制，而本公司業務可能受損。我們也可能面臨來自未來產品的額外競爭。

為維持市場競爭力，我們可能決定改變LUPKYNIS的價格、劑型與劑量強度及其他行銷策略，包括調整折扣或回扣的金額或可得性。任何此類變更可能對淨產品銷售產生短期或長期的負面影響，而可能導致本公司業務與營運結果受損。價格上漲或改變行銷策略也可能對本公司聲譽及我們取得並維持LUPKYNIS的報銷覆蓋能力造成負面影響，而可能導致需求減少，使本公司業務與營運結果受損。若我們無法成功為LUPKYNIS定價或行銷，LUPKYNIS的商業前景將受到限制，而本公司業務可能受損。
我們對LUPKYNIS潛在市場規模的估計係基於相關上市產品的處方與銷售數據、臨牀試驗結果、醫學文獻及其他資訊。若LUPKYNIS的潛在市場規模小於我們的估計，LUPKYNIS的商業前景可能受到限制，而本公司業務可能受損。

患有LN的患者可能病情嚴重。在AURORA 1和AURA-LV中，接受LUPKYNIS 23.7毫克每日兩次治療且發生率≥3%的最常見不良反應為：腎小球過濾率下降、高血壓、腹瀉、頭痛、貧血、咳嗽、泌尿道感染、上腹部疼痛、消化不良、脫髮、腎功能不全、腹部疼痛、口腔潰瘍、疲勞、震顫、急性腎臟損傷及食慾減退。部分接受LUPKYNIS治療的患者可能因基礎疾病而死亡或遭遇不良事件（可能與藥物相關或不相關）。
因此，我們可能面臨產品責任訴訟。雖然我們擁有產品責任保險，但針對我們的產品責任訴訟可能導致我們產生重大負債，並降低LUPKYNIS的銷售。此外，任何此類訴訟可能損害本公司業務聲譽，並導致監管機構啟動調查。
